description: This file defines the 'Block' data structure and related functions for managing blocks within the focalboard project, including validation, patching, and metadata stamping.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a basic data unit in the focalboard system, including metadata such as ID, parent, creator, timestamps, type, title, fields, and deletion status.

classes.name: BlockPatch
classes.description: Represents a set of modifications to be applied to a Block, including optional fields for parent ID, schema, type, title, updated fields, and deleted fields.

classes.name: BlockPatchBatch
classes.description: A batch of block IDs and corresponding patches for bulk modifications.

methods.name: BlocksFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON data from an io.Reader into a slice of Block pointers.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the Block object, checking for empty BoardID, title size limits, and fields size limits.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Creates a lightweight clone of the Block for logging purposes, including ID, ParentID, BoardID, and Type.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a BlockPatch to a Block, updating its fields accordingly.

methods.name: StampModificationMetadata
methods.description: Updates blocks with the user ID and current timestamp, optionally adding audit metadata.

methods.name: ShouldBeLimited
methods.description: Determines if a block should be limited based on its type and update timestamp.

methods.name: GetLimited
methods.description: Returns a limited version of the block containing only ID, type, title, and icon field.
